mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for a bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, permits are almost always required for a bathroom addition because it involves significant structural, plumbing, and electrical work. Failing to obtain proper permits can lead to costly delays, fines, and potential issues when selling your home. Hometelligent Inc. assists clients with navigating the permitting process with local authorities in our service areas like Oakland and Fremont to ensure compliance.
